info.title: IAmina API
info.description: Diabetes companion API — Flutter web/iOS/Android + 3rd party integrations

post.description: Create a sovereign Django identity without fabricating patient facts.
Authenticate one Django account using a normalized email identifier.
Establish or rotate the native credential without weakening ownership.
Send a native recovery link without disclosing account existence.
Consume a one-time Django recovery token and revoke prior IAMINA tokens.
Migrate or resolve one verified Firebase identity, then issue IAMINA auth.
Explicitly attach a verified Firebase UID to the current Django account.

delete.description: Remove the migration credential only when native recovery is available.

post.description:
Injects 30 days of realistic glucose logs for the current authenticated user.
Idempotent — skips if the user already has ≥ 20 entries.

get.description:
Liveness + readiness probe.

- DB unreachable → 503 (blocks gunicorn from receiving traffic)
- Cache unavailable → 200 degraded (non-fatal: falls back to DB)

Paginated log list.  Query params: ?page=1&page_size=50.
page_size is clamped to [1, 200] to prevent runaway queries.

patch.description: Partial update — only supplied fields are written.  404 on cross-patient access.
Persist only explicitly supplied patient-declared profile fields.

get.description: Return every supported raw-media consent option for the authenticated patient.

put.description: Grant or reactivate one exact raw-media purpose/modality permission.

delete.description: Revoke one exact raw-media permission; repeated revocation is idempotent.

patch.description: Confirm only explicitly supplied dimensions for the authenticated patient.

delete.description: Revoke one dimension without changing any other patient preference.

get.description:
Return evidence-gated KPIs for the authenticated patient.

Raw SQL remains descriptive source data. Normative CGM labels such as TIR,
CV stability, GMI and GRI are returned only when the governed CGM sufficiency
contract verifies actual coverage. The current LogEntry schema cannot prove
wear-time/cadence, so those fields fail closed to null rather than being
inferred from the fraction of rows labelled ``source='cgm'``.
Summarize repeated observations without causal or treatment inference.

post.description:
Explicitly evaluate and consume at most one non-urgent insight candidate.

This is intentionally a POST because a surfaced item updates deterministic
delivery bookkeeping (`last_surfaced_at` and delivery signature). Safe GET
requests must not consume the patient's attention budget.

get.description: Return governed companion state without consuming proactive attention budget.

post.description: Record explicit AI processing consent without inventing patient facts.

delete.description: Withdraw AI processing consent. AI features remain suspended until re-consent.
Delete the authenticated patient's account and associated patient data.

post.description:
Enrol the authenticated patient into *module_name*.

Returns 404 if the module is not registered with the chassis ModuleRegistry.
Idempotent — calling twice does not create a duplicate row.

get.description: Return all modules currently active for the authenticated patient.

post.description:
Import a LibreLink / LibreView CSV file for the authenticated patient.

Accepts multipart/form-data with a single field ``csv_file``.
Idempotent: re-uploading the same file produces zero new rows.

Returns:
    imported        — number of new LogEntry rows created
    duplicates      — rows skipped because client_uuid already existed
    rejected_values — rows dropped for out-of-physiological-range glucose
    skipped_rows    — rows dropped for unparseable timestamp or missing value
    detected_format — "librelink_detailed" | "simple" | "unknown"
    sample          — first 3 parsed readings (for UI preview)

Stage 1 (confirm=False): Extract and validate.  Returns preview.
Stage 2 (confirm=True):  Persist from a previously staged batch_id
                         passed as query param ?batch_id=<uuid>.

Persist a previously staged extraction (batch_id from /ingest response).
Called when the user taps "Confirmer" in the Flutter UI.

get.description: Return the most recent LabReport rows for the authenticated patient.

post.description:
Full Phase 6 analytical pipeline.

Step 1: SQL computes all KPIs (never Python arithmetic).
Step 2: Pattern detection engine runs against ORM queryset.
Step 3: SemanticCompressor → English pivot text.
Step 4: Gemini interprets and generates empathetic patient response.

get.description:
GET /api/v1/ai/doctor-brief?days=14

Generates a compact medical summary (narrative + doctor_brief + key_insight)
using IAmina's narrator module. Intended for pre-consultation export.

Returns all three fields from the SUMMARY_USER prompt:
  - narrative: warm patient-facing summary
  - key_insight: the single most important observation
  - doctor_brief: one-sentence clinical digest for the physician

post.description:
Phase 6 chat with English Pivot Layer.

Note: TriageVitalMiddleware has already screened 'data.message' upstream.
If this view is reached, the message is NOT a medical emergency.

Steps:
  1. Fetch minimal KPIs for context (SQL, lightweight).
  2. Compress into English pivot chat context.
  3. Build English system prompt + FR/Darija user message.
  4. Call LLM → respond in patient language.

Phase 11-D — Gemini Vision glucometer OCR for web clients.

POST /api/v1/ai/analyze-glucometer-image
Body: { "image_base64": "<base64>", "mime_type": "image/jpeg" }

Mobile uses on-device ML Kit (offline, faster).
Web uses this endpoint as fallback.

Phase 11-C — Gemini Vision meal recognition.

POST /api/v1/ai/analyze-meal-image
Body: { "image_base64": "<base64>", "mime_type": "image/jpeg" }

Pipeline:
  1. MealVisionShield validates input (mime type, size, base64 sanity).
  2. Gemini Vision identifies visible foods (English Pivot prompt).
  3. MealVisionShield sanitises output (max 8 French food names).
  4. Flutter maps returned names to CulinaryItem chips (fuzzy match).

No patient clinical data is sent to the LLM — only the food image.
fallback=True in the response means Flutter must ask the user to pick manually.

get.description:
GET /api/v1/ai/chat/stream?message=...
Returns Server-Sent Events — one `data:` line per token chunk.
Terminal event: `data: [DONE]`

post.description:
POST /api/v1/ai/voice
Content-Type: multipart/form-data

Fields:
  audio        — audio file (mp4 / m4a / webm / wav / ogg / mpeg / flac)
  context_days — look-back window for clinical context (default 14)

Returns:
  transcript   — what IAmina heard (display as subtitle in Flutter)
  reply        — IAmina's text reply (pass to flutter_tts for playback)
  is_emergency — if True, Flutter should display the emergency UI immediately

POST /api/v1/ai/transcribe
Content-Type: multipart/form-data

STT-only — no IAmina pipeline.
Used for inline dictation on the add-log page (meal note field).

Returns:
  transcript — verbatim transcription of the audio clip
  confidence — "high" | "medium" | "low" (length heuristic)

get.description:
Return retention + engagement KPIs for the staff dashboard.

Requires: request.user.is_staff == True.

Args:
    module: module_id whose manifest.acquisition_event is used as the
            cohort acquisition anchor. Defaults to "diabetes".

Returns: JSON object matching the shape defined in the API spec.
